data.name: Jameelu
data.gender_notes: Jameelu is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'Jamal' which means 'beauty' or 'handsome'. In Islamic tradition, Jameelu represents the physical and moral beauty that pleases Allah. The name Jameelu carries the meaning “Beautiful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jameelu usually hope their child will grow to embody beautiful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes inner and outer beauty, and a desire to please Allah in all aspects of life.
data.etymology: Jameelu belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Beautiful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jameelu total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: جَمِيل

in_urdu.name: جمیل
in_urdu.meaning: جمیل نام کے معنی: خوبصورت، اچھی نَسلیں، اچھی چھاتی
in_urdu.long_meaning: جمیل نام کا تعلق خوش نَسلی، اچھی چھاتی سے ہے، اس نام کو اسلامی روایات میں بہت اہمیت دی گئی ہے، اس میں خوبصورتی اور اچھی نَسلیں شامل ہیں، جو مسلم والدین کی رائے میں اچھا نام ہے

in_hindi.name: जमील
in_hindi.meaning: जमील नाम का अर्थ: सुंदर, अच्छी नस्ल, अच्छी छाती
in_hindi.long_meaning: जमील नाम का अर्थ अच्छी नस्ल और अच्छी छाती से जुड़ा हुआ है, यह नाम हिंदू-मुस्लिम सभ्यता में बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है, इस नाम को मुस्लिम परिवारों द्वारा पसंद किया जाता है, जो अच्छी नस्ल और सुंदरता का प्रतीक है

This name is often given to children, especially girls, in the hope that they will grow up to be beautiful and noble individuals.

Therefore, Jameelu can be seen as a reminder to constantly strive for self-improvement, both in terms of our physical appearance and our inner character.

historical_references.reference: The name Jameelu is derived from the Arabic word 'jamal' meaning 'beauty' or 'handsomeness'. It is believed that the name originated during the Umayyad Caliphate (661-750 AD) and was given to a famous poet and scholar named Al-Jameel Al-Qaisi. His poetry was renowned for its beauty and elegance, thus earning him the name Jameel (handsome) Al-Qaisi.

Another reference to the name Jameelu can be found in the context of the famous mosque complex Jameel Mosque in Naqshbandi, Uzbekistan. The mosque was built during the Timurid Empire (1370-1507 AD) and is renowned for its intricate and beautiful decorations, reflecting the name Jameel (beautiful) given to it.
